events.title: v0.10 - Map
events.summary: Added a map upgrade (it's cheap!) - Shows all the artifacts, and you can preview them - Shows the location of all your baskets There will be more upgrades to come that allow you to improve the map even moreMinor tweaks to have pieces are placed to make it feel better

events.title: v0.9.7
events.summary: "Keen Eye" now uses a golden sheen instead of green, and is in general more noticeableSome artifacts had a really strong glossy effect under the room light, this has been reducedClicking a basket whilst holding a basket no longer bugs out the basketNon-DirectX 12 hardware should be able to launch the game nowRemoved background room noise, it was mostly annoying noise anywayInverted rotation applies in the artifact preview now tooThank you to all of you who have provided feedback! Much appreciate

events.title: v0.9.4 - Control Improvements
events.summary: Changes:Invert Y option for both mouse movement and rotatingAdded axis lock when rotating a piece, toggle it with TTweaked snapping to make it feel betterMinor performance improvement

events.title: v0.9 Update
events.summary: The Next Fest has started! If you're just seeing the game, try out the demo! It should provide you with 1-2 hours of content, and your progress will carry over to the full game! And if you've already played, perhaps you'll want to try to get all the achievements? There's a new speedrun one... 👀 New changes: - More plants in the demo area - Butterflies! - Little birds on the roof, try and spot them! - Added a skip tutorial button- Minor fixesHope you enjoy! Don't forget to wishlist the game!

events.title: v0.8.1
events.summary: The next courtyard is a bit more developed, have a peak through the door!Rotating a piece is more consistent without it getting stuckThe piece you're carrying has a white outline when obscured by somethingAfterglow switched to use yellow instead of green glowBasket has a pickup/drop soundReduced the size of the game by about 200MB

events.title: v0.8.0 - Two new demo achievements
events.summary: Two new achievements: Master's Pace - Complete the demo in under two hours Just Me and My basket - Complete the demo with no upgrades Perhaps you can try to get both in one run? Other changes:- Achievements screen. events.title: Patch v0.7.3
events.summary: Fixed a rare freeze during the startup shader warmup, where loading could deadlock.Mac builds: the game now has macOS buildsPerformance: every artifact piece now draws with a single merged material. This means less work for the GPU and CPU, especially in views with lots of fragments on screen.Expanded tutorialYou can open the shop and artifact views while carrying the basket.The settings menu is less see through, easier to useMinor fixes

events.title: Demo out!
events.summary: Interested in solving some 3D puzzles in a cozy peaceful environment? Try the Kintsugi Cottage demo, showcasing the first introductory part of the game. Your progress in the demo will carry over to the full game! So don't worry about having to redo the same content if you choose to complete the demo If you find any issues, please use the feedback form in the pause menu. Thank you! Hope you enjoy! If you like it, don't forget to wishlist the full game!
